meta.sourceName: Deportation Data Project — processed ICE arrests
meta.sourceRelease: Latest available ICE enforcement release covers records through Aug. 6, 2026 (published Aug. 24, 2026; processed release updated Sept. 22, 2026).
meta.sourceCitation: Government data provided by ICE in response to a FOIA request, processed by the Deportation Data Project, and analyzed by Indivisible Fair Oaks.
meta.coordinateSource: U.S. Census Bureau 2025 Gazetteer place internal points, with manual coordinates for selected cities and neighborhoods.
meta.method: De-duplicated individual arrest records grouped by the manually entered apprehension city and state, matched to Census place centroids. Counts are assigned to the city field, not street-level incident locations.
meta.releaseNote: Latest available ICE enforcement release checked Nov. 15, 2026; no newer release was available.
